title: Output relations under a correspondence (H5's rest): the same verdicts under JBMC and auto --confirm
description: A regression check's correspondence (step H5 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md) may now give an output relation for the result in place of --results-agree-when: a boolean over old.result, new.result and the new parameters. A result that is an object of an application class is in it, or in --results-agree-when, by its field paths of whatever shape in each version, read through the objects in the harness's bytecode; identity relations are still compared. jvmcontract equivalence takes the correspondence as JSON with --correspondence FILE. lib/tests/heap.rs checks five such checks on the own checker inline: objects.Kernel#price, whose long result became a Money value object, related by old.result == new.result.cents (verified; a cent too much refuted); the foundations fixture's shop.Pricing#withQuantity between Quote(long, int) and Quote(Money, int), its result related by its field paths (verified; the alias-to-copy defect refuted by result == q; a relation the versions break refuted). This job runs the ignored test that repeats the five under --engine jbmc and under --engine auto --confirm.
expected: exits 0: the ignored test passes. Under both engines, the two after-build checks are Verified and the three others Violation, each violation's witness run on a JVM (counterexample.jvm set).

resources.notes: a release build of the crate, then 10 small JBMC runs (loop-free harnesses of a few dozen instructions)

steps.name: output relations under JBMC and auto --confirm
steps.run: cd lib && cargo test --release --test heap -- --ignored output_relations
